sketch:
Observe: SVG energy-level diagram (horizontal lines E_n < 0) for an
atom; a "photon" ball with adjustable hν slider approaches. If hν
matches an allowed transition E_n − E_m, the ball is absorbed and
the atom jumps; otherwise it passes through. HUD reads current n.
Experiment: 3 seeded target transitions; student sets hν to trigger
each. Evaluate: transition lines hidden; only ground state and
target n shown; student picks hν from ΔE alone. Wrinkle: introduces
quantization as "only certain hν work" — sharp contrast with
continuous classical spectrum.
